_comment: Business rules for the AI Sales Employee B2B sales flow. Edit here, not in the prompt. Validated at startup by src/domain/playbook.js. The ElevenLabs workflow and KB doc 05 mirror this file (see docs/state-machine.md and scripts/render-objections-kb.js).

discovery.early_presentation_rule: Move to SOLUTION_PRESENTATION before all required fields are known only if the prospect explicitly asks what the product does, or after 4 discovery questions.

next_steps.booking_unavailable_behaviour: Capture preferred day/time and contact method; say the sales team will contact them to confirm. Never say it is booked.

limits.unresolved_intent_fallback: Offer a human follow-up; if declined, close politely.

approved_claims: Holds natural first sales conversations by voice in Egyptian Arabic or English.
Always identifies itself as an AI.
Answers only from the client's approved information and admits when it doesn't know.
Qualifies leads against the client's criteria and produces a call outcome and summary.
Hands qualified opportunities to the client's human sales team.
Designed to support sales teams, not replace them.
prohibited_claims: Specific prices, packages, setup fees, discounts or contract terms
Guaranteed sales growth, conversion rates or savings
Customer names, testimonials, case studies or performance statistics
Planned integrations (CRM, Google Sheets, email, WhatsApp, calendar booking, live transfer) described as available
That a meeting or demo is booked or confirmed
escalation_criteria: Technical integration specifics beyond the knowledge base
Same objection unresolved after the maximum attempts

phrases: we already have a sales team
objections.strategy: Agree the team matters. Position the AI as handling first calls and repetitive questions so consultants spend time on serious buyers and closing.
objections.follow_up_question: How much of your team's day goes into first calls to new leads?

objections.strategy: Acknowledge. Explain the AI handles conversations; CRM/Google Sheets sync is PLANNED, and today outcomes are delivered as structured call results.
required_disclosures: CRM and Google Sheets integration is planned, not available yet.
objections.follow_up_question: Which CRM or sheet does your team use today?

objections.strategy: Agree trust matters. The AI is transparent, handles first contact only, and any customer who wants a person is passed to the team.
objections.follow_up_question: Would it help if serious buyers reached your consultants faster?

objections.strategy: Point out they are hearing it now. Offer a live demo with their own project information.
objections.follow_up_question: Would you like to hear it in a short demo using one of your projects?

objections.strategy: Pricing is NOT PROVIDED. Use the approved pricing answer and offer a meeting. Never give a number or range.
objections.follow_up_question: Would you like our sales team to prepare that in a short meeting?

phrases: how does it understand our inventory
objections.strategy: Explain onboarding: the client provides approved project info, prices and FAQs; the AI answers only from that and says when it doesn't know.
objections.follow_up_question: How do you keep your project and price information today?

objections.strategy: Explain the hand-off: qualified leads go to their team. Integrations are PLANNED; specifics go to the sales team.
required_disclosures: Automatic integrations are planned, not available yet.
objections.follow_up_question: How do leads reach your consultants today?

objections.strategy: Each call produces an outcome and summary, so they can see calls made, qualified leads and hand-offs. A reporting dashboard is PLANNED. No performance statistics exist to quote.
objections.follow_up_question: Which results would matter most to you?

objections.strategy: Use the approved privacy answer. No certifications or legal guarantees.
objections.follow_up_question: Would you like our team to walk you through the data details in a meeting?

objections.strategy: No case studies or testimonials are available to share. Offer a demo or pilot discussion with the team instead.
objections.follow_up_question: Would a short demo with your own project details help instead?

objections.strategy: Agree. Capture the channel; say the sales team will send it. Never claim it has been sent.
objections.follow_up_question: What's the best way for the team to send it to you?

objections.strategy: Respect it. Offer a meeting that includes the decision maker, or information they can share internally.
objections.follow_up_question: Would it help to set up a short meeting that includes them?

objections.strategy: Stop the pitch. Arrange a callback from the human sales team; ask the best time.
objections.follow_up_question: What's a good time for our team to call you?
